description: Adds tags to, and removes tags from, many contacts at once, without touching their other tags: add and remove are lists of tag names, at least one tag in all. The contacts are contact_ids, up to 1,000 ct_ ids, or filter, the contact list’s own filters (q, tag, connection_id, portfolio_id), where an empty filter is every contact you can see. An id of no contact you can see is skipped and left untouched. The change stays inside Cosend. Returns how many contacts were matched, changed and skipped.

filter.description: The contacts `GET /v1/contacts` lists with these filters: `q` searches the name, the phone digits and the username; `tag` keeps contacts with every tag given; `connection_id` keeps contacts on any of these numbers; `portfolio_id` keeps one business’s. `{}` is every contact you can see.

name: tag_contacts
title: Tag or untag many contacts
